item.title: Accountability in AI-Enabled Decision Support: Delegation, Oversight, and Decision Quality
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines accountability challenges that arise when artificial intelligence systems support human decision-making. It focuses on how responsibility is distributed between AI systems and human users, the mechanisms required for effective oversight, and the impact on overall decision quality.

The call invites research that addresses the governance, transparency, and accountability frameworks necessary for AI-enabled decision support systems across various domains and contexts.

Appel publié par Decision Support Systems. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

Potential topics

  • Accountability in AI-enabled decision support
  • Delegation in AI systems
  • Oversight mechanisms
  • Decision quality
